content: ActiveStorage S3: blob.url generates a presigned GET URL whose default expiry is 300 seconds (5 minutes); overridable per call with url(expires_in:) or app-wide with config.active_storage.urls_expire_in. Public buckets (service: S3 with public: true) yield unsigned permanent URLs. Redirect mode (rails_blob_url) 302s to the presigned S3 URL; proxy mode streams through the Rails app and requires the app itself to be publicly reachable. Presigned URLs expiring before the consumer fetches is a classic failure mode (rails issue 32236).
